name: themecc
description: Claude Code desktop and CLI themes collected by ThemeCC. Unofficial, not affiliated with Anthropic.

plugins.name: cli-acid-lime
plugins.description: Electric lime and mint accents with a hot red for errors. High energy, high saturation.

plugins.name: cli-amber-crt
plugins.description: A monochrome amber phosphor look, like an old CRT terminal. Almost every color is a shade of amber.

plugins.name: cli-aubade
plugins.description: A light theme with an indigo accent and soft warm text, named for a morning song.

plugins.name: cli-ayu-dark
plugins.description: A sky-blue accent with lime success and orange warning colors, based on the Ayu palette.

plugins.name: cli-ayu-light
plugins.description: The Ayu Light variant: a clear blue accent with green success and soft red errors on a light base.

plugins.name: cli-ayu-mirage
plugins.description: The medium-dark Ayu Mirage variant: a light blue accent with lime success and coral errors.

plugins.name: cli-bong
plugins.description: A warm sand accent with sage green success and teal plan mode, on a dark brown base.

plugins.name: cli-campbell
plugins.description: The Campbell color scheme from Windows Terminal: a royal blue accent with the classic ANSI green, red, and yellow.

plugins.name: cli-carbonfox
plugins.description: The Carbonfox scheme: a bright blue accent with pink errors and near-black neutral backgrounds.

plugins.name: cli-catppuccin-frappe
plugins.description: The Frappé flavor of Catppuccin: a pastel blue accent on a mid-tone blue-gray base.

plugins.name: cli-catppuccin-latte
plugins.description: The light Catppuccin flavor, with pastel accents tuned for a white terminal.

plugins.name: cli-catppuccin-macchiato
plugins.description: The Macchiato flavor of Catppuccin: a pastel blue accent, between Frappé and Mocha in darkness.

plugins.name: cli-catppuccin-mocha
plugins.description: The darkest Catppuccin flavor: a pastel blue accent with soft green, red, and yellow status colors.

plugins.name: cli-citrus-ink
plugins.description: A bright lime accent with warm coral errors and a pale citrus plan-mode color.

plugins.name: cli-cyberpunk
plugins.description: A cyan accent with acid green success, magenta errors, and yellow warnings on a deep navy base.

plugins.name: cli-dawnfox
plugins.description: The light Dawnfox scheme: a teal-blue accent and plum text on a warm pink-beige background.

plugins.name: cli-daybreak
plugins.description: A light theme with a calm teal accent and earthy status colors, easy on the eyes in daylight.

plugins.name: cli-dracula
plugins.description: The official Dracula theme for Claude Code. It uses the ANSI base, so it follows the Dracula palette set in your terminal.

plugins.name: cli-driftwood
plugins.description: A muted teal accent with soft cream text, like weathered wood and sea glass.

plugins.name: cli-eclipse
plugins.description: A calm sky-blue accent with teal plan-mode borders and clear green, red, and amber status colors.

plugins.name: cli-eldritch
plugins.description: Eldritch: a bright cyan accent with neon green success and yellow warnings on a dark purple-gray base.

plugins.name: cli-everforest
plugins.description: A soft aqua accent with gentle green, red, and sand status colors from the Everforest palette.

plugins.name: cli-everforest-light
plugins.description: The light Everforest scheme: a sky-blue accent and slate text on a soft cream-green background.

plugins.name: cli-flexoki-dark
plugins.description: Flexoki's dark scheme: warm paper-like text, a blue accent, and inky status colors.

plugins.name: cli-flexoki-light
plugins.description: Flexoki's light scheme: ink-colored text on warm paper, with a deep blue accent.

plugins.name: cli-forge-ember
plugins.description: Glowing amber and orange accents with a cream text color, like embers in a forge.

plugins.name: cli-frostbyte
plugins.description: A light theme in icy blues with a slate text color and cool, readable status colors.

plugins.name: cli-github-dark
plugins.description: A blue accent with green success and coral error colors, from the GitHub dark palette.

plugins.name: cli-github-dark-colorblind
plugins.description: GitHub's colorblind-friendly dark scheme: blue for success and orange for errors instead of green and red.

plugins.name: cli-github-dark-dimmed
plugins.description: GitHub's dimmed dark scheme: a softer blue accent and lower contrast than GitHub Dark.

plugins.name: cli-github-dark-high-contrast
plugins.description: GitHub's high-contrast dark scheme: brighter blue, green, red, and yellow for readability.

plugins.name: cli-github-light
plugins.description: The GitHub light palette, with the familiar blue accent and readable status colors on white.

plugins.name: cli-graphite
plugins.description: A restrained steel-blue accent on a neutral gray base with desaturated status colors.

plugins.name: cli-green-phosphor
plugins.description: A monochrome green phosphor look, like a classic CRT terminal. Almost every color is a shade of green.

plugins.name: cli-gruvbox
plugins.description: A muted aqua accent with warm retro red, green, and mustard status colors, based on the Gruvbox palette.

plugins.name: cli-gruvbox-dark-hard
plugins.description: The hard-contrast Gruvbox Dark variant: a yellow accent with bright green, red, and cream text on a very dark base.

plugins.name: cli-gruvbox-material-dark
plugins.description: A softer take on Gruvbox with an aqua accent, sage green success, and warm cream text.

plugins.name: cli-gruvbox-material-light
plugins.description: The light Gruvbox Material scheme: a teal accent and brown text on a warm cream background.

plugins.name: cli-halcyon
plugins.description: A soft periwinkle accent with muted pink errors and sage success colors, based on Halcyon.

plugins.name: cli-high-contrast
plugins.description: Pure white text and bright, saturated accents on the dark preset, for maximum readability.

plugins.name: cli-horizon
plugins.description: A cyan accent with coral-pink errors and peach warnings on a dark base, based on Horizon.

plugins.name: cli-ink-and-ember
plugins.description: Warm ember orange on a brown-gray palette, with olive success and a soft coral for errors.

plugins.name: cli-kanagawa
plugins.description: Muted ink-blue and wave colors inspired by Hokusai's The Great Wave off Kanagawa.

plugins.name: cli-kanagawa-dragon
plugins.description: The darker Dragon variant of Kanagawa, with a pale blue-gray accent and muted earthy status colors.

plugins.name: cli-letterpress
plugins.description: A printed-page light theme: ink blue accent, warm paper text, and restrained olive and brick status colors.

plugins.name: cli-matcha-zen
plugins.description: A calm light theme in teal and green with warm text, inspired by matcha and quiet tea rooms.

plugins.name: cli-miami-heat
plugins.description: Hot pink errors, aqua accents, and a pale pink text color, inspired by 1980s Miami.

plugins.name: cli-nebula-drift
plugins.description: A periwinkle accent with pink-red errors and mint success, on a deep indigo base.

plugins.name: cli-neon
plugins.description: An original high-contrast neon palette: orange accent, neon green text and success, and bright red errors over near-black.

plugins.name: cli-night-owl
plugins.description: A deep blue theme with a periwinkle accent and green success, based on Night Owl.

plugins.name: cli-nightfox
plugins.description: The Nightfox scheme: a steady blue accent with soft green, rose, and gold status colors.

plugins.name: cli-nord
plugins.description: Cool arctic blues and muted frost tones on a dark base, ported from the Nord palette.

plugins.name: cli-one-dark
plugins.description: The familiar Atom One Dark colors: a soft blue accent with green, red, and amber status colors.

plugins.name: cli-opaline
plugins.description: A pearly blue accent with soft mint success and peach warnings on a muted indigo base.

plugins.name: cli-oxblood
plugins.description: A burnt orange accent with warm pink-white text on a dark red-brown base.

plugins.name: cli-oxocarbon
plugins.description: IBM Carbon-style colors: a bright blue accent, mint green success, and pink errors on a dark base.

plugins.name: cli-oxocarbon-light
plugins.description: The light Oxocarbon scheme: a vivid IBM blue accent with slate text on a cool gray background.

plugins.name: cli-patina
plugins.description: A copper-green accent with sage success and a deep green-gray base, like oxidized bronze.

plugins.name: cli-porcelain
plugins.description: A clean light theme with a strong blue accent and cool gray text, like glazed white ceramic.

plugins.name: cli-prism
plugins.description: A bright blue accent with cyan plan mode and well-separated pink, mint, and yellow status colors.

plugins.name: cli-rose-pine
plugins.description: A soft foam-blue accent with rose and gold status colors, from the Rosé Pine palette.

plugins.name: cli-rose-pine-dawn
plugins.description: The light Rosé Pine variant: soft warm paper tones with muted rose and pine accents.

plugins.name: cli-rose-pine-moon
plugins.description: The Moon variant of Rosé Pine: a soft iris accent with rose errors on a dusky purple base.

plugins.name: cli-selenized-dark
plugins.description: Selenized Dark: a blue accent on a teal-tinted base, with colors designed for even perceived contrast.

plugins.name: cli-selenized-light
plugins.description: Selenized Light: a blue accent and slate text on a warm cream background.

plugins.name: cli-solarized-dark
plugins.description: A blue accent with muted green, red, and yellow status colors from the Solarized palette, tuned for low contrast.

plugins.name: cli-solarized-light
plugins.description: The light Solarized theme: a warm cream feel with carefully balanced accent colors.

plugins.name: cli-synthwave
plugins.description: Electric cyan accents with hot pink-red errors and neon yellow warnings, in the style of Synthwave '84.

plugins.name: cli-terafox
plugins.description: The Terafox scheme: a muted teal-blue accent with coral errors on a deep green-teal base.

plugins.name: cli-tokyo-night
plugins.description: A soft blue accent with green success and pink-red error colors, from the Tokyo Night palette.

plugins.name: cli-velvet-court
plugins.description: A lavender accent with rose pink text and plum backgrounds, like a velvet curtain.

plugins.name: cli-verdigris
plugins.description: A blue-green accent with parchment text on a dark forest base.

plugins.name: cli-vesper
plugins.description: Vesper: a muted sage accent with peach warnings and gray text on a near-black base.

plugins.name: deep-field
plugins.description: A self-playing asteroid field drifts behind the conversation, with dark frosted panels and cyan and orange accents.

plugins.name: firefly-meadow
plugins.description: A summer night seen from eye level: swaying tall grass, drifting fireflies, twinkling stars, and the odd shooting star.

plugins.name: rainy-window
plugins.description: A halftone-dot room on a rainy day: rain on the window, a spinning record, string lights, and a mascot typing at a desk.

plugins.name: themes-for-claude
plugins.description: A bundle of 12 live ASCII wallpapers, such as Moonlit, Koi Pond, Neon Rain, and Sakura Dusk, plus 5 color themes, picked from a strip above the prompt.
